project_meta.latest_user_direction: User explicitly requested a much closer visual copy of gtatown.com. Reference captured directly in-browser: midnight navy page gradient #111222/#1f1f38, Barlow Condensed 700/800 display, Plus Jakarta Sans UI, pale yellow #fff9cb headings, pale pink #ffb2c6 controls; compact nav, YOUR GTA 6 PAUSE MENU left with six white-selected menu rows and thumbnails, large night map right, rounded Jump in image grid, compact latest-news cards. This direction supersedes the initial invented neon-brutalist homepage. Retain existing English Vice Atlas brand and working content/search/saved flows.

design_synthesis_concept.rockstar_games_vi_dna: Monumental condensed Art Deco & brutalist typography, warm Vice sunset palette (bubblegum neon pink, peach cream, deep ocean obsidian), kinetic poster-first hero with masked line-by-line staggered reveal, film-grain texture, and cinematic character duos (Jason & Lucia).
design_synthesis_concept.gtatown_com_dna: Structured field-intel explorer architecture: six Leonida territories, interactive interactive dossier modals, map coordinate badges, vehicle garage metadata, crime-beat radio/news timeline, and bookmarkable local collections.
design_synthesis_concept.hybrid_breakthrough: 'Cinematic Neon Brutalism' — high-end editorial meets tactical surveillance terminal. Every card feels like classified satellite field intel stamped in Vice Beach neon.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the default Emergent splash screen in /app/frontend/src/App.js with the ultimate unified Vice City Companion portal.
2. Use clean React .js with Lucide icons and Framer Motion.
3. Implement the custom SVG logo mark: A bold, stylized Roman numeral 'VI' intertwined with a tropical palm neon silhouette and 'VICE TOWN // LEONIDA' subtitle.
4. Feature a persistent cinematic audio-atmosphere simulation (ambient ocean & city synth hum using Web Audio API or rhythmic pulse toggle) so users feel like they are inside the Rockstar teaser.

5. Include full interactive tabs: 1) Territory Map & Intel, 2) Character Dossiers (Jason vs Lucia compare mode), 3) Vehicle Garage with filterable specs, 4) Dispatch News Feed, and 5) My Saved Evidence Locker (saved to localStorage with counter badge).
6. Include an official Trailer popover modal (embed official Rockstar GTA VI Trailer YouTube video: 'QdBZY2fkU-0' with play/pause and 4K cinema wrapper).
7. Implement an interactive image lightbox with zoom, camera coordinates, and 'Save to Evidence Locker' bookmark toggle.
8. Guarantee strict WCAG contrast on all buttons and tags, never use full transparency on nav/overlays, and ensure all buttons and test points have descriptive data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Every text over image must use radial/linear scrim overlays (bg-black/60 to bg-black/85 at base) with text-shadow for absolute legibility.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_convention: kebab-case data-testid on every tab, modal toggle, bookmark button, card, and filter button.
